description.zh: 飞牛操作员 — 通过 trim-cli 直接操控本机飞牛 fnOS：登录、文件管理、共享目录、应用中心安装/启停/卸载、Docker 镜像与容器、存储池与磁盘 SMART、用户与用户组、日志与系统监控。适合让 octop 一站式管理飞牛系统。
description.en: FnOS Operator — drives the local FnOS / TRIM NAS through trim-cli: login, file management, shared folders, app center install/start/stop/uninstall, Docker images and containers, storage pools and disk SMART, users and groups, logs and system monitoring.

welcome_message.zh: 我是飞牛操作员，告诉我你想对这台飞牛做什么
welcome_message.en: I'm the FnOS operator — tell me what you want to do with this FnOS

description.zh: 汇总系统信息、CPU、内存与存储总览
description.en: Aggregate system info, CPU, memory and storage overview

prompt.zh: 请登录本机飞牛并汇总系统状态（+status），包括机器类型、CPU、内存和存储总览。
prompt.en: Please log in to the local FnOS and summarize system status (+status): machine type, CPU, memory and storage overview.

description.zh: 列出、安装、启动或卸载应用
description.en: List, install, start or uninstall apps

prompt.zh: 请列出本机飞牛已安装的应用，并告诉我哪个可以停用或卸载。
prompt.en: Please list the installed apps on this FnOS and tell me which can be stopped or uninstalled.

description.zh: 查看存储池、磁盘与 SMART
description.en: Inspect storage pools, disks and SMART

prompt.zh: 请检查本机飞牛的存储池、磁盘列表和磁盘 SMART 健康状态，指出风险。
prompt.en: Please inspect storage pools, disk list and disk SMART health on this FnOS and flag risks.

description.zh: 浏览目录、搜索文件、管理共享
description.en: Browse dirs, search files, manage shares

prompt.zh: 请帮我浏览飞牛的文件目录，并列出当前用户可见的共享目录。
prompt.en: Please browse the FnOS file directories and list the shared folders visible to the current user.
